competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency names six increments (2s, 5s, 10s, 20s, 50s, 100s); the samples only ever exercise 20s (seeds 43, 46), 50s (44, 45), and 100s (42), so half the named increments are never demonstrated.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Counting by 2s, 5s, and 10s -- three of the six increments explicitly named in the competency -- do not appear in any of the 7 samples; only 20s (seeds 43, 46), 50s (seeds 44, 45), and 100s (seed 42) are exercised, with 20s and 50s each repeated across two seeds.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sequences like '0, 100, 200, 300, ___' and the ordering task in seed 50 are short, single-step, and fit grade 2 quarter 1 counting demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats vary (mcq, cloze, ordering, read_mcq) but all of them test the same three increments repeatedly (20s, 50s, 100s) rather than surfacing the missing 2s, 5s, or 10s cases.

competency_alignment.rationale: Where increments are tested, the variation legitimately targets the skip-counting skill named, e.g. seed 42's '0, 100, 200, 300, ___' correctly isolates the by-100s pattern.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency caps this node 'not beyond 1000,' but the largest number across all 7 samples is 400 (seed 42); nothing approaches the stated ceiling even in the by-100s sequence.
